name: Adam
summary: The first man, formed from the dust of the ground and placed in the garden of Eden.

name: Eve
summary: The first woman, called the mother of all living, who ate the forbidden fruit.

name: Cain
summary: Adam and Eve's firstborn, a tiller of the ground who killed his brother in a field.

name: Abel
summary: A keeper of sheep whose offering God accepted, killed by his jealous brother.

name: Seth
summary: The son Eve bore after Abel's death, given in his place, who lived 912 years.

name: Enoch
summary: A man who walked with God and was taken by him, so that he did not see death.

name: Methuselah
summary: Enoch's son, whose 969 years are the longest life recorded in the Bible.

name: Noah
summary: Built an ark at God's command and was saved with his family and the animals from the flood.

name: Abraham
summary: Called by God to leave his country, promised a son in old age and descendants beyond counting.

name: Sarah
summary: Abraham's wife, who laughed at God's promise and gave birth to Isaac in her old age.

name: Hagar
summary: Sarah's Egyptian maid, mother of Ishmael, whom an angel met in the wilderness.

name: Ishmael
summary: Abraham's son by Hagar, sent into the wilderness, who became the father of twelve princes.

name: Lot
summary: Abraham's nephew who chose the plain of Jordan and was led out of Sodom by angels.

name: Melchizedek
summary: King of Salem and priest of the most high God, who blessed Abraham with bread and wine.

name: Isaac
summary: The son God promised to Abraham and Sarah, laid on the altar and spared.

name: Rebekah
summary: Isaac's wife, found at a well, mother of the twins Esau and Jacob.

name: Esau
summary: A hairy hunter, Jacob's twin, who sold his birthright for a bowl of stew.

name: Jacob
summary: Isaac's son who dreamed of a ladder to heaven, wrestled with God and was renamed Israel.

name: Leah
summary: Jacob's first wife, given to him in her sister's place, mother of six of his sons.

name: Rachel
summary: The wife Jacob loved most and worked fourteen years for, mother of Joseph and Benjamin.

name: Dinah
summary: Jacob and Leah's daughter, whose brothers avenged her at Shechem.

name: Reuben
summary: Jacob's firstborn, who talked his brothers out of killing Joseph.

name: Judah
summary: Jacob's son who suggested selling Joseph, and from whose tribe the kings of Israel came.

name: Joseph
summary: Jacob's favourite son with the coat of many colours, sold by his brothers and raised to rule Egypt.

name: Benjamin
summary: Jacob's youngest son, in whose sack Joseph's silver cup was hidden.

name: Potiphar
summary: Captain of Pharaoh's guard, who bought Joseph and put him over his house.

name: Job
summary: A blameless man from the land of Uz who lost everything yet would not curse God.

name: Moses
summary: Drawn out of the Nile as a baby, he spoke with God at the burning bush and led Israel out of Egypt.

name: Aaron
summary: Moses' brother and spokesman, Israel's first high priest, whose rod budded.

name: Miriam
summary: Moses' sister, a prophetess who led the women in song with a timbrel after the Red Sea.

name: Jochebed
summary: A Levite mother whose children were Aaron, Moses and Miriam.

name: Pharaoh
summary: The king of Egypt who hardened his heart and would not let Israel go until the plagues.

name: Zipporah
summary: Moses' wife, a daughter of the priest of Midian.

name: Jethro
summary: Priest of Midian and Moses' father-in-law, who advised him to share the work of judging.

name: Joshua
summary: Moses' assistant who led Israel into the promised land and brought down the walls of Jericho.

name: Caleb
summary: One of the twelve spies, who trusted God and was given Hebron at eighty-five.

name: Korah
summary: A Levite who rebelled against Moses and was swallowed up when the earth opened.

name: Balaam
summary: A prophet hired to curse Israel, stopped by an angel and rebuked by his own donkey.

name: Balak
summary: King of Moab who sent for Balaam to curse Israel, only to hear him bless them.

name: Bezaleel
summary: A craftsman filled with God's Spirit to make the tabernacle and the ark of the covenant.

name: Rahab
summary: A woman of Jericho who hid Israel's spies and was saved by a scarlet cord.

name: Achan
summary: Took forbidden spoil from Jericho and hid it in his tent, bringing defeat on Israel.

name: Deborah
summary: A prophetess who judged Israel under a palm tree and sent Barak to battle.

name: Barak
summary: The commander who would only go to battle against Sisera if Deborah went with him.

name: Jael
summary: Welcomed the fleeing general Sisera into her tent, then drove a tent peg through his head.

name: Sisera
summary: Captain of a Canaanite army with nine hundred iron chariots, killed by a woman in her tent.

name: Gideon
summary: Called while threshing wheat in hiding, he tested God with a fleece and won with three hundred men.

name: Jephthah
summary: A mighty man of Gilead who made a rash vow before fighting the Ammonites.

name: Samson
summary: A Nazarite of great strength who killed a lion with his bare hands and brought down a Philistine temple.

name: Delilah
summary: The woman from the valley of Sorek who coaxed out the secret of Samson's strength.

name: Manoah
summary: A man of Zorah whose barren wife was promised a son by an angel.

name: Ehud
summary: A left-handed judge who hid a dagger on his right thigh to deliver Israel from Moab.

name: Eglon
summary: A very fat king of Moab who oppressed Israel for eighteen years.

name: Othniel
summary: Israel's first judge, who captured a city and won Caleb's daughter as his wife.

name: Ruth
summary: A Moabite widow who would not leave her mother-in-law, gleaned in Boaz's field and married him.

name: Naomi
summary: A widow who returned to Bethlehem in bitterness, with her loyal daughter-in-law beside her.

name: Boaz
summary: A wealthy man of Bethlehem who let a widow glean in his fields and became her kinsman-redeemer.

name: Orpah
summary: Naomi's Moabite daughter-in-law who kissed her goodbye and returned to her people.

name: Eli
summary: The priest at Shiloh who raised young Samuel but could not restrain his own sons.

name: Hannah
summary: Prayed so hard for a son at Shiloh that the priest thought she was drunk, then gave him to the LORD.

name: Elkanah
summary: A man of Ramathaim who asked his weeping wife, 'Am not I better to thee than ten sons?'

name: Samuel
summary: Heard God call his name as a boy in the temple, and later anointed Israel's first two kings.

name: King Saul
summary: Israel's first king, head and shoulders taller than everyone, who grew jealous of David.

name: Jonathan
summary: King Saul's son, whose soul was knit with David's in a lifelong friendship.

name: Michal
summary: Saul's daughter who loved David, helped him escape, and later despised him for dancing.

name: David
summary: The shepherd boy who killed Goliath with a sling, became king and wrote many psalms.

name: Goliath
summary: A Philistine champion from Gath, over nine feet tall, who defied the armies of Israel.

name: Jesse
summary: A man of Bethlehem who brought seven sons before Samuel before the youngest was sent for.

name: Abigail
summary: A wise woman who rode out with gifts to stop David taking revenge on her foolish husband.

name: Nabal
summary: A rich, churlish sheep-owner whose name means fool, who refused to help David's men.

name: Bathsheba
summary: Seen bathing by King David from his roof; later the mother of Solomon.

name: Uriah
summary: A loyal Hittite soldier whom David had placed at the front of the battle to die.

name: Nathan
summary: The prophet who told David a story about a poor man's lamb and said, 'Thou art the man.'

name: Absalom
summary: David's handsome son who stole the hearts of Israel and rebelled against his father.

name: Joab
summary: Commander of David's army, fierce and loyal, who killed Absalom against the king's wishes.

name: Abner
summary: Captain of Saul's army, killed by Joab at the gate of Hebron.

name: Mephibosheth
summary: Jonathan's son, lame in both feet, who ate at King David's table for his father's sake.

name: Solomon
summary: David's son who asked God for wisdom and built the temple in Jerusalem.

name: Rehoboam
summary: Solomon's son whose harsh answer to the people split the kingdom in two.

name: Jeroboam
summary: First king of the northern kingdom, who set up golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

name: Queen of Sheba
summary: A queen who travelled with spices and gold to test Solomon's wisdom with hard questions.

name: Elijah
summary: The prophet fed by ravens, who called down fire on Mount Carmel and went up in a whirlwind.

name: Elisha
summary: Called from his plough, he asked for a double portion of his master's spirit and did many miracles.

name: Ahab
summary: A king of Israel who served Baal, coveted Naboth's vineyard and was struck by a random arrow.

name: Jezebel
summary: A queen from Sidon who promoted Baal, threatened Elijah and was thrown from a window.

name: Naboth
summary: Refused to sell his family vineyard to the king and was stoned on false charges.

name: Naaman
summary: A Syrian army captain with leprosy, healed after dipping seven times in the Jordan.

name: Gehazi
summary: A prophet's servant who ran after a healed general for silver and was struck with his leprosy.

name: Jehu
summary: A commander anointed king of Israel, famous for driving his chariot furiously.

name: Hezekiah
summary: A faithful king of Judah who prayed when sick unto death and was given fifteen more years.

name: Josiah
summary: Became king at eight, found the book of the law in the temple and turned Judah back to God.

name: Manasseh
summary: A king of Judah who reigned 55 years, did great evil, then humbled himself in chains.

name: Jehoshaphat
summary: A king of Judah who proclaimed a fast and sent singers ahead of his army.

name: Asa
summary: A king of Judah who removed idols, but in his old age sought physicians instead of the LORD.

name: Athaliah
summary: Seized the throne of Judah and tried to destroy the whole royal family.

name: Joash
summary: Hidden in the temple as a baby, he was crowned at seven and repaired the house of the LORD.

name: Uzziah
summary: A king of Judah who grew proud, burned incense in the temple and was struck with leprosy.

name: Isaiah
summary: Saw the LORD high and lifted up in the temple and answered, 'Here am I; send me.'

name: Jeremiah
summary: The weeping prophet, called as a youth, who was thrown into a muddy dungeon for his warnings.

name: Baruch
summary: The scribe who wrote down a prophet's words on a scroll and read them in the temple.

name: Jonah
summary: Ran from God's call to Nineveh and spent three days inside a great fish.

name: Hosea
summary: A prophet told to marry an unfaithful wife as a picture of God's love for Israel.

name: Amos
summary: A herdman from Tekoa who said he was no prophet, yet was sent to warn Israel.

name: Micah
summary: A prophet from Moresheth who foretold that a ruler would come out of Bethlehem.

name: Haggai
summary: A prophet who urged the returned exiles to finish rebuilding the temple.

name: Zechariah
summary: A prophet of the return from exile who saw visions explained by an angel.

name: Huldah
summary: A prophetess in Jerusalem consulted when the book of the law was found in the temple.

name: Micaiah
summary: The one prophet who told the king the truth, and was put in prison for it.

name: Nebuchadnezzar
summary: King of Babylon who destroyed Jerusalem, set up a golden image and ate grass like an ox.

name: Zedekiah
summary: The last king of Judah, blinded and carried in chains to Babylon.

name: Sennacherib
summary: King of Assyria who besieged Jerusalem and lost 185,000 men in a single night.

name: Daniel
summary: Taken to Babylon as a youth, he interpreted the king's dreams and was thrown into a den of lions.

name: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego
summary: Three young men who would not bow to the golden image and walked unharmed in a fiery furnace.

name: Belshazzar
summary: A king of Babylon who saw a hand write on the wall during his feast and died that night.

name: Darius
summary: The king tricked into a law that sent Daniel to the lions, who ran to the den at dawn.

name: Cyrus
summary: King of Persia who let the Jews return home and rebuild the temple, named by Isaiah long before.

name: Ezekiel
summary: A priest among the exiles who saw a valley of dry bones come to life.

name: Esther
summary: A Jewish orphan who became queen of Persia and risked her life to save her people.

name: Mordecai
summary: A Jew in the palace at Shushan who would not bow to Haman and was honoured by the king.

name: Haman
summary: A proud official who plotted to destroy the Jews and was hanged on the gallows he built.

name: Ahasuerus
summary: King of Persia who reigned from India to Ethiopia and made a Jewish orphan his queen.

name: Vashti
summary: A queen of Persia who refused to appear at the king's feast and lost her crown.

name: Ezra
summary: A priest and ready scribe who led exiles home and read the law aloud to the people.

name: Nehemiah
summary: The king's cupbearer who went home to rebuild Jerusalem's walls in fifty-two days.

name: Zerubbabel
summary: Governor of Judah who led the rebuilding of the temple: 'Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit.'

name: Zacharias
summary: An old priest struck dumb in the temple for doubting an angel's news of a son.

name: Elisabeth
summary: Barren into old age, her baby leaped in her womb when Mary greeted her.

name: John the Baptist
summary: Wore camel's hair, ate locusts and wild honey, and baptised Jesus in the Jordan.

name: Mary, mother of Jesus
summary: A young woman of Nazareth told by the angel Gabriel that she would bear the Son of God.

name: Joseph, husband of Mary
summary: A carpenter of the house of David, warned in dreams to take his family to Egypt.

name: Mary Magdalene
summary: Freed from seven devils, she was the first to see Jesus after he rose from the dead.

name: Mary of Bethany
summary: Sat at Jesus' feet to listen while her sister served, and later anointed him with costly ointment.

name: Martha
summary: Busy with serving when Jesus visited, she was told her sister had chosen the better part.

name: Lazarus
summary: A friend of Jesus from Bethany, called out of his tomb after four days.

name: Simeon
summary: A devout old man promised he would not die before seeing the Lord's Christ, who held baby Jesus in the temple.

name: King Herod
summary: The king troubled by the wise men's news, who ordered the children of Bethlehem killed.

name: Herodias
summary: Held a grudge against John the Baptist and had her daughter ask for his head.

name: Peter
summary: A fisherman who walked on water, denied Jesus three times, and preached at Pentecost.

name: Andrew
summary: A fisherman who brought his brother to Jesus, and a boy with five loaves too.

name: James, son of Zebedee
summary: A fisherman called from mending nets, the first apostle to be killed for his faith.

name: John the apostle
summary: The disciple whom Jesus loved, who saw the visions of Revelation on the isle of Patmos.

name: Philip the apostle
summary: An apostle from Bethsaida who said 'Come and see' and asked Jesus to show them the Father.

name: Matthew
summary: A tax collector who left his table to follow Jesus and threw a great feast.

name: Thomas
summary: Wouldn't believe until he saw the nail prints, then cried, 'My Lord and my God.'

name: Judas Iscariot
summary: The apostle who betrayed Jesus with a kiss for thirty pieces of silver.

name: Nicodemus
summary: A Pharisee who came to Jesus by night and was told he must be born again.

name: Zacchaeus
summary: A short, rich tax collector who climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus pass by.

name: Jairus
summary: A synagogue ruler who begged Jesus to come to his dying twelve-year-old daughter.

name: Pontius Pilate
summary: The Roman governor who asked 'What is truth?' and washed his hands before the crowd.

name: Caiaphas
summary: The high priest who said it was better for one man to die for the people.

name: Barabbas
summary: A notable prisoner the crowd chose to release instead of Jesus.

name: Joseph of Arimathaea
summary: A rich, secret disciple who asked Pilate for Jesus' body and laid it in his own new tomb.

name: Nathanael
summary: Asked if any good thing could come out of Nazareth; Jesus called him an Israelite without guile.

name: Matthias
summary: Chosen by lot to take Judas' place among the twelve apostles.

name: Stephen
summary: Full of faith and the Holy Ghost, he saw heaven open as he was stoned, the first Christian martyr.

name: Philip the evangelist
summary: Ran alongside a chariot to explain Isaiah to an Ethiopian official, then baptised him.

name: Paul
summary: A persecutor blinded on the road to Damascus who became an apostle and wrote many letters.

name: Barnabas
summary: A Levite from Cyprus called the son of consolation, who sold his field and travelled with Paul.

name: Ananias of Damascus
summary: A disciple sent by the Lord to lay hands on the blinded Saul so he could see again.

name: Cornelius
summary: A Roman centurion told by an angel to send for Peter, whose household received the Holy Ghost.

name: Dorcas
summary: A disciple at Joppa known for making coats and garments, raised to life when Peter prayed.

name: Lydia
summary: A seller of purple from Thyatira whose heart the Lord opened by the riverside at Philippi.

name: Silas
summary: Sang hymns at midnight in a Philippian jail until an earthquake opened the doors.

name: Timothy
summary: A young disciple from Lystra whom Paul called his own son in the faith.

name: Titus
summary: A Greek believer Paul left in Crete to set things in order.

name: Onesimus
summary: A runaway servant who met Paul in prison and was sent back as a brother.

name: Priscilla
summary: A tentmaker who, with her husband, worked with Paul and taught Apollos the way of God more perfectly.

name: Aquila
summary: A Jewish tentmaker from Pontus who opened his home to Paul in Corinth.

name: Apollos
summary: An eloquent Jew from Alexandria, mighty in the scriptures: 'I have planted, Apollos watered.'

name: Luke
summary: The beloved physician who stayed with Paul to the end.

name: Mark
summary: A young helper who left Paul's first journey, later called profitable for the ministry.

name: Felix
summary: A Roman governor who trembled when Paul spoke of judgment, and kept him in prison two years.

name: Festus
summary: A Roman governor who heard Paul appeal to Caesar and told him much learning had made him mad.

name: King Agrippa
summary: A king who heard Paul's defence and said, 'Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.'

name: Gamaliel
summary: A respected Pharisee and teacher of the law who warned the council not to fight against God.

name: James, brother of Jesus
summary: A leader of the church in Jerusalem who wrote that faith without works is dead.

name: Jude
summary: Brother of James, who wrote a short letter urging believers to contend for the faith.
